description: Symfony bundle for Amazon RDS IAM token authentication and master-password refresh in Doctrine DBAL
rules: Configure the bundle through environment variables: AWS_REGION, RDS_IAM_USERNAME, RDS_SECRET_ARN. A null or empty value disables the corresponding mode.
Keep the regular DoctrineBundle connection configuration. The bundle does not replace it.
Reuse database connections through FrankenPHP worker mode or RDS Proxy before you enable IAM authentication under a high connection rate.
